title: 日本ダービーの後に・希望の灯光

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The race is finished—Narita Top Road places first. For the first time, Admire Vega feels a sense of regret.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: However, it is that exact feeling that fuels her for the next race.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Next is the final race of the Classic Triple Crown, the Kikuka Sho. Admire Vega promises her rivals that they will compete once again there.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And so, they happily await the approaching summer.
